question: Roswaal has affinity for all types of magic, so if he was fighting in a four-man party (sort of like Dragon Quest), who would be the recommended members? (If four is too many, fewer is fine, too)
answer: How about a super-attack party like Garfiel (warrior), Emilia (hero), Roswaal (sage), Subaru (jester), so even if Subaru is just dancing in the back, they can win.
